AI Body & Nutrition Analyzer

Answer a few questions about your body, lifestyle, training and eating habits to get a personalized (non-medical) nutrition & fitness strategy.

Log in

Your data stays on this device only — nothing is sent anywhere.
This is a lightweight local profile switch, not secure authentication — anyone with access to this device/browser can see stored answers. Use it to keep separate profiles, not to protect sensitive data.

Visible tabs

Hide any tabs you don't use so the nav bar only shows what matters to you. Today always stays visible since it's the home view.

Settings

Appearance

Language / Idioma

AI Assistant (optional)

Speak or type a summary of your day on the "AI Log" tab, and let AI turn it into food, activity, and habit entries for you to review before saving. Requires a free API key from one of the providers below — your key is stored only in this browser and sent directly to that provider, never anywhere else. Nothing is ever saved to your logs without your review and approval.
Get a free key: Gemini · Groq · OpenRouter

Backup & Restore

Save a complete copy of your data (including photos) as a file on your computer, or restore from one. Useful for moving your data into a fresh copy of this app (like right after publishing it online) — export here first, then import it there.

Cloud Sync (optional)

Use this app on more than one device (like your phone) with the same data. Requires a free Firebase project — see the setup guide for step-by-step instructions. Paste your project's config below to turn it on; leave it empty to keep everything local-only, exactly as before. Progress photos sync too, via Firebase Storage rather than embedded in your data — see the setup guide for a one-time Storage rules step.

My exercises

          
Save exercises you do often so they show up as a one-click quick pick above instead of retyping the name and category each time. Tag one to a split so it only shows up when that split is selected.

          

            

              

              

                
              

              

                
              

            

            

              

              

              

              

            

            
For a Cardio exercise, set Distance + Speed for a fixed route (calories/duration then calculate automatically each time you log it), or just Speed alone for something like treadmill running where you'll enter the distance per session. Add a Duration override if your actual time for that route doesn't match the flat distance÷speed estimate (hills, stops, etc.) — calories will then be based on your real duration instead. For cardio with no distance at all (dancing, swimming), leave Distance/Speed blank and set a MET value instead — combined with a Duration, calories calculate the same way as the standard exercises do.

            

              
              
            

          

          

        

      


      

        

          
Daily physical condition questions

Export for your AI Coach

        
One click builds a readable summary of your profile, trends, nutrition, activity, habits, commitments, and your own day notes — plus anything you want to ask below — asks Claude to act as your personal trainer and follow a fixed report structure every time, and downloads roughly one front/back progress photo per week plus your full raw scale-log and nutrition-log CSVs (bundled into one "coach-export-files.zip" so your browser doesn't block multiple downloads at once). Unzip it, paste the text, and attach the files into a chat with Claude for a direct, objective review. Use "My Plan" (click your name) to choose which sections the export focuses on. This is not medical advice; anything that sounds medical should go to a real doctor instead.

        

          
          
          

            
            
          

        

        

          
          
          
        

        

        
"Ask AI Coach now" uses the free API key from Settings → AI Assistant and reviews your data right here — text and full CSV logs only, no progress photos (fast, one click). "Generate full export" is the deeper option: it also bundles your progress photos, for pasting into any AI chat of your choice.

Set rest day?

    
    

      Recovery is where the actual gains happen — your muscles rebuild and get stronger during rest, not during the workout itself.
      


      A few things worth doing today:
      
• Sleep 7-9 hours if you can — most repair happens then.
      
• Keep protein and water intake up, same as a training day.
      
• Light walking or stretching is fine and can even speed recovery.
      
• Skipping planned rest days is a common way people end up overtrained or injured — one day off now keeps tomorrow's session strong.
